units.purpose: Runs the spec-driven workflow. The feature-pipeline skill and the /opsx commands call it.
Runs the local Apple on-device model server. The apfel-eval skill and the llm_ops/eval project call it.
units.requires: A Mac with Apple Intelligence and Homebrew

units.purpose: Installs the Python packages of llm_ops/eval in its devcontainer. They are the run packages, the test tools, and the gate tools.
check: import deepeval, openai, dotenv, httpx2, pytest, mutmut, ruff
units.install: npx @devcontainers/cli up --workspace-folder llm_ops/eval && npx @devcontainers/cli exec --workspace-folder llm_ops/eval pip install -r requirements-dev.txt
units.requires: Node.js 20 or newer, and Docker with a running daemon
